import os

ssa = andes.load(case_path, setup=True, no_output=True, log=False)

result_json = {
    "slack_bus": slack_bus_idx,
    "slack_setpoint": round(slack_setpoint, 6),
    "slack_voltage": slack_voltage,
    "selected_count": selected_count
}
